title_en: ការស្វាគមន៍ប្រចាំថ្ងៃ
subtitle: Starting conversations, introducing yourself, and polite phrases
description: Essential English lines for everyday conversations: meet and greet, introductions, polite questions and warm goodbyes. Includes native audio and Khmer meanings.

spine.title: Conversation Flow · របៀបសន្ទនា
spine.note: A natural step-by-step flow: greet warmly, introduce yourself, chat politely, and say goodbye.

explain.title: At a glance · មើលមួយភ្លែត
explain.why: Starting a conversation in English is simple: smile, greet warmly, state your name, and ask how the other person is doing.

cards.alt: A morning sun rising over the horizon
cards.ko: Good morning! How are you doing today?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: A polite morning greeting asking how someone is feeling or doing.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ អរុណសួស្តី! តើអ្នកសុខសប្បាយជាទេថ្ងៃនេះ?

cards.ko: I am doing well, thank you. And you?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: A positive response showing gratitude and asking back about the other person.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំសុខសប្បាយធម្មតាទេ អរគុណច្រើន។ ចុះអ្នកវិញ?

cards.alt: An identification badge with a photo slot
cards.ko: My name is Vuthchan. It is nice to meet you.
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: Used to state your name and express pleasure in meeting someone for the first time.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ វុឌ្ឍច័ន្ទ។ រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានស្គាល់អ្នក។

cards.ko: I am from Cambodia. Where are you from?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: Tells your country of origin and asks about the other person's hometown or country.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំមកពីប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។ តើអ្នកមកពីណាដែរ?

cards.alt: A warm coffee cup with steam
cards.ko: How has your day been so far?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: A friendly small-talk question asking about someone's activities and mood today.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើថ្ងៃនេះអ្នកយ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ?

cards.ko: Could you please help me with this?
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: A polite request asking someone for assistance or guidance on a task.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើអ្នកអាចជួយខ្ញុំបន្តិចបានទេ?

cards.alt: A clock showing the time to go
cards.ko: I have to get going now. It was great talking to you.
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: A polite way to end a conversation when you need to leave.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំត្រូវទៅឥឡូវនេះហើយ។ រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានជជែកជាមួយអ្នក។

cards.ko: Have a wonderful day and see you later!
cards.en:
💡 Meaning: A warm farewell wishing someone well until the next time you meet.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ សូមឱ្យមានថ្ងៃដ៏ល្អ ហើយជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ!

qa.title: Common Questions · សំណួរដែលតែងជួបញឹកញាប់

items.q: How should I respond to 'How are you?'
items.qen: តើខ្ញុំគួរឆ្លើយតបយ៉ាងដូចម្តេចចំពោះសំណួរ 'How are you?'
items.a: A natural reply is 'I am doing well, thank you! How about you?' rather than only saying 'I am fine'.
items.aen:
💡 English: Saying 'I am doing well' and asking back shows genuine courtesy.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ចម្លើយបែបធម្មជាតិគឺ 'I am doing well, thank you! How about you?' ជាជាងឆ្លើយតែមួយម៉ាត់ 'I am fine'។
items.why: Asking 'How about you?' returns the courtesy and keeps the conversation flowing smoothly.

qa.title: Everyday Questions · សំណួរទូទៅ

items.q: How do I tell someone what I do?
items.qen: តើខ្ញុំគួរប្រាប់គេអំពីការងារ ឬការរៀនសូត្ររបស់ខ្ញុំយ៉ាងដូចម្តេច?
items.a: You can say 'I work in technology' or 'I am learning English right now'.
items.aen:
💡 English: Use 'I work in [field]' or 'I am learning [subject]'.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ អ្នកអាចនិយាយថា 'I work in technology' ឬ 'I am learning English right now'។

qa.title: Survival Lines · ឃ្លាពេលស្តាប់មិនទាន់

items.ko: Could you please speak a little slower?
items.en: 💡 English: Requesting the speaker to reduce speed · 🇰🇭 តើអ្នកអាចជួយនិយាយយឺតៗបន្តិចបានទេ?

items.ko: Sorry, could you repeat that again?
items.en: 💡 English: Asking someone to repeat what was just said · 🇰🇭 សុំទោស តើអ្នកអាចជួយនិយាយម្តងទៀតបានទេ?

vocab.title: Greetings · ការស្វាគមន៍

items.en: 💡 Used as a greeting when meeting someone · 🇰🇭 សួស្តី
💡 Polite greeting used from early morning until noon · 🇰🇭 អរុណសួស្តី
💡 Greeting used from noon until late afternoon · 🇰🇭 ទិវាសួស្តី (ពេលរសៀល)
💡 Polite expression when meeting someone for the first time · 🇰🇭 រីករាយដែលបានស្គាល់

vocab.title: Everyday Phrases · ឃ្លាប្រចាំថ្ងៃ

items.en: 💡 Expression of appreciation and gratitude · 🇰🇭 អរគុណ
💡 Polite response when someone thanks you · 🇰🇭 មិនអីទេ / ដោយក្តីរីករាយ
💡 Used to politely get attention or apologize briefly · 🇰🇭 សុំទោស / សុំការអនុញ្ញាត
💡 Polite word used when making a request · 🇰🇭 សូម / មេត្តា

vocab.title: Parting Words · ពាក្យលាគ្នា

items.en: 💡 Expression used when parting or leaving someone · 🇰🇭 លាហើយ
💡 Friendly farewell expecting to meet again soon · 🇰🇭 ជួបគ្នាឆាប់ៗ
💡 Caring expression wishing safety and health · 🇰🇭 ថែរក្សាខ្លួន
💡 Polite wish for someone to enjoy the rest of their day · 🇰🇭 សូមឱ្យមានថ្ងៃល្អ

full.title: Greetings · ការស្វាគមន៍
full.ko: Good morning! How are you doing today? I am doing well, thank you. And you?
full.en:
💡 Meaning: A polite morning greeting asking how someone is feeling or doing.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ អរុណសួស្តី! តើអ្នកសុខសប្បាយជាទេថ្ងៃនេះ? 💡 Meaning: A positive response showing gratitude and asking back about the other person.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំសុខសប្បាយធម្មតាទេ អរគុណច្រើន។ ចុះអ្នកវិញ?

full.title: Introductions · ការណែនាំខ្លួន
full.ko: My name is Vuthchan. It is nice to meet you. I am from Cambodia. Where are you from?
full.en:
💡 Meaning: Used to state your name and express pleasure in meeting someone for the first time.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ វុឌ្ឍច័ន្ទ។ រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានស្គាល់អ្នក។ 💡 Meaning: Tells your country of origin and asks about the other person's hometown or country.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំមកពីប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។ តើអ្នកមកពីណាដែរ?

full.title: Small Talk · ការសន្ទនាទូទៅ
full.ko: How has your day been so far? Could you please help me with this?
full.en:
💡 Meaning: A friendly small-talk question asking about someone's activities and mood today.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើថ្ងៃនេះអ្នកយ៉ាងម៉េចដែរ? 💡 Meaning: A polite request asking someone for assistance or guidance on a task.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ តើអ្នកអាចជួយខ្ញុំបន្តិចបានទេ?

full.title: Goodbyes · ការលាគ្នា
full.ko: I have to get going now. It was great talking to you. Have a wonderful day and see you later!
full.en:
💡 Meaning: A polite way to end a conversation when you need to leave.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ ខ្ញុំត្រូវទៅឥឡូវនេះហើយ។ រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានជជែកជាមួយអ្នក។ 💡 Meaning: A warm farewell wishing someone well until the next time you meet.
🇰🇭 ខ្មែរ៖ សូមឱ្យមានថ្ងៃដ៏ល្អ ហើយជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ!
